definitions.explanation: Heavy cloth stretched on a frame for oil or acrylic painting, and by extension the painting surface itself. Also the strong cotton cloth used for shoes and bags.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧キャンバス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧キャンバス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧まま、⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{動|うご}かなかった→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: The painter sat in front of the blank canvas for hours without moving.

notes:
Also written カンバス, an older spelling. In boxing and wrestling キャンバス is also the floor of the ring.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- キャンバス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to paint on canvas
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧なキャンバス: a blank canvas
- キャンバス{地|じ}: canvas cloth (bags, shoes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧: oil painting, the usual use of a canvas
- ⟦パレット→パレット：33230_paretto⟧: palette
